definitions.name: G0C.RLE
definitions.body: 'RV' BIND RV 1 DROP RV 0 GET 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT [ 'RX' BIND 'RA' BIND RA LENGTH 1 SUB 'RL' BIND RA RL GET 'RP' BIND RA RL RP 0 GET RP 1 GET 1 ADD 2 COLLECT PUT RA RX 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 RP 0 GET RX EQ SELECT GET ] FOLD
definitions.note: Run-length encoding of a non-empty Vector of integers as [ value count ] pairs, via FOLD over a pair accumulator.

definitions.name: G0C.DIVS
definitions.body: 'GDK' BIND 1 GDK RANGE [ 'GDD' BIND GDK GDD DIV 'GDQ' BIND GDQ FLOOR GDQ EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: Positive divisors of a positive integer, ascending.

definitions.name: G0C.PRIMES
definitions.body: 'GPN' BIND 1 GPN RANGE [ 'GPK' BIND GPK G0C.DIVS LENGTH 2 EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: Primes less than or equal to a positive integer, ascending (uses G0C.DIVS).

definitions.name: G0C.BSTEP
definitions.body: 'GSC' BIND 'GSS' BIND GSS GSS LENGTH 1 SUB GET 'GST' BIND GST GSC 2 COLLECT JOIN 'GSQ' BIND GSQ '()' EQ NOT GSQ '[]' EQ NOT AND NOT 'GSM' BIND GSS GSS LENGTH 1 SUB TAKE GSS GSC 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 GSM SELECT GET
definitions.note: One bracket-stack step: (stack, char) to stack. Pops when top and char form a matched pair, else pushes the char. Stack starts with a '$' sentinel.

definitions.name: G0C.ORDERS
definitions.note: Parse the orders JSON String into the Vector of order Records.

definitions.name: G0C.REV
definitions.body: [ 'OX' BIND OX 'price' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'OY' BIND OY 'qty' GET OY 'price' GET MUL ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: Total of qty times price over the order Records that have a price (exact rational).

definitions.name: G0C.WORDS
definitions.body: ' ' TOKENIZE [ 'MW' BIND MW '' EQ NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: Words of a space-separated String as a Vector, with empty pieces dropped.
